bio: On the Benedettu peninsula, tucked away in the vegetation by the beach, this contemporary haven is the younger sibling of Casadelmar – its "casual" beachfront version. Everything happens on the terrace looking out to the Gulf of Porto Vecchio from beneath driftwood pergolas that blend into the landscape. In this divine setting, select your dishes from a menu of refined brasserie cuisine with Italian influences: vitello tonnato, tuna crudo, fritto misto, grilled lobster, appetising pasta dishes and fresh salads. The classic desserts absolutely do the job: profiteroles, tiramisu, lemon meringue pie. The freshness and quality of the ingredients inspire confidence.
